limits: No Docker build, image startup, Linux execution or registry publication was performed.
Node 22 is selected to match repository engines but no local Node 22 executable was available; native commands ran Node 25.5.0.
Online clean-install resolution was rejected by automatic approval review because internal package names could be sent to the public npm registry; no retry was made.
Offline clean-install resolution stopped on uncached axios (ENOTCACHED), so clean dependency installation remains unproven.
Compiled module import used existing installed dependencies and did not invoke main, connect to a database or Temporal, initialize schedules, or prove poller readiness.
The existing /ready endpoint is unconditional after startup and does not monitor ongoing Temporal poller health.
Architecture verification exercised shell selection with stubbed downloads; it did not execute Linux kubectl binaries.
Native command harnesses and logs are local temporary artifacts, not permanent CI test registration.
Source hashes were recorded after the Docker-only edits; the isolated worker compilation used unchanged worker and TypeScript configuration sources.
